- **Summary**: Experience an all-suite ultra-luxury river voyage aboard the Sun Goddess Nile Cruise between Luxor and Aswan, featuring 30 private-terrace suites, gourmet dining, and private Egyptologist shore guiding.

- **Inclusions**: Full-board luxury accommodation in a private-terrace suite (buffet breakfast, lunch, and à la carte dinner); Private-terrace suite with individually controlled air conditioning, LED TV, safe, minibar, and luxury bath amenities; Scheduled shore excursions accompanied by a licensed English-speaking Egyptologist guide; All private transfers between airport/station and cruise ship in modern air-conditioned vehicle
